White-Label — Governed Configuration

"Northstar Invest Card, powered by Arta" — a fictional online brokerage issuing on Arta's rails. Per Arta’s clarification, the product — a portfolio-secured charge card — sits inside the partner’s own product shell: the Arta core modules (pledge consent, Key Terms, decisioning) are embedded and non-removable; the shell, entry points and brand are the partner’s. What differs is a partner theme file (Layer 3) and a product configuration contract (Layer 2). Platform core (Layer 1) is locked by the token pipeline.

Layer 1 · Locked
Arta platform coreSecurity, KYC/AML model, decisioning, status model, disclosure hierarchy, consent logging, accessibility, AI guardrails, error/pending/declined patterns.
Layer 2 · Governed
Product configurationEligibility, fees, advance rates by asset class, rewards rules, settlement, servicing SLA, market disclosures — contract-controlled data, not design.
Layer 3 · Partner
Partner expressionBrand name & logo, card art, palette within contrast limits, entry point, marketing copy, support channel, illustration, some typography.
